template.title: Weekly progress report from a tracker export
template.author: claude-opus-5-5 (frontier author; hand-written 2026-10-21 for research/surface-20261021 BUILDER-1, adapted from the stub template in app/core/builder.mjs)
template.whenToUse: Someone wants a regular summary of what a team finished (and optionally what is open or blocked), taken from their task tracker export, e-mailed to one person.
template.notFor: Status pages, dashboards, reading Jira/Linear/Asana live, sending to a whole team list, or reports about money, sales or alerts.
sources: experiments/library/cards/catalog.json P01 linear pipeline, P04 draft -> check -> deliver

slots.name: team
slots.description: Name of the team or project the report is about (used in the title and subject).

slots.name: recipient
slots.question: Who should get the report? (one e-mail address)
slots.askWhy: This is the only choice that sends your data somewhere. I will not guess it.
slots.description: The one e-mail address that receives the report.

slots.name: listOpen
slots.description: Also list the items that are still open, not only the finished ones.

data.tracker: one row per work item: title, status (done | open | blocked), owner

willDo: Read the tracker sheet and count the finished, open and blocked items
List the finished items in the report

willDo.text: List the items that are still open

willDo: Save the report on this machine
E-mail it to [[recipient]] only, after you approve each send
Check that what was sent is exactly what was saved
willNotDo: Send to anyone else, or more than one message per run
Read Jira, Linear or Asana directly: it reads the tracker sheet you keep in the workspace
Run by itself on a schedule: there is no scheduler yet, so you (or your coding agent) start each run
Use a model: this flow has no model step

workflow.title: Weekly report for [[team]]
workflow.goal: Each run, count what [[team]] finished in the tracker sheet, write a short report, save it, and e-mail it to [[recipient]] after a person approves the send.

assumptions: The tracker sheet in the workspace holds one row per item with a title, a status (done, open or blocked) and an owner
Delivery is a local outbox file standing in for e-mail; nothing leaves this machine
risks: Sending the report to the wrong person
A report that silently drops items
successCriteria: Every item has a status the report counts (done, open or blocked)
The report is delivered to the one recipient you named
What was delivered is exactly the saved report (checked by re-reading the outbox)
unsupported: Running on a schedule by itself
Reading Jira, Linear or Asana directly
Sending to anyone other than the named recipient

nodes.description: Find items whose status the report would not count (used by a check)
Count every item a second, independent way
Send the report to [[recipient]] (asks you first)
Re-read what was delivered and compare it with the saved report
